nodes.label: Reproducible CI and Release-engineering Baseline
nodes.source_location: Aggiornamento — riproducibilità, CI e release engineering
nodes.rationale: Five thematic commits establish locked Python environments, mandatory multi-version and PostgreSQL tests, real container and migration gates, Windows-safe logs, and supply-chain evidence.

nodes.label: Controlled Server and On-premise Vendability
nodes.rationale: The product is considered sellable through controlled server or on-premise delivery after contractual, operational, backup, observability, and signed-update controls are completed.

nodes.label: Human-reviewed Report Service
nodes.rationale: Reviewed opportunity-intelligence reports are the recommended initial commercial offer because they validate quality and conversion before broader automation.

nodes.label: Public SaaS Readiness Gap
nodes.rationale: A public self-service SaaS remains premature due to legal, infrastructure, operational, benchmark, UX, and product-governance gaps despite the completed application-security foundation.

nodes.label: Priority 1 — Legal and Commercial Review
nodes.rationale: Google Places terms, Italy/EU privacy and marketing rules, LGPL/MPL obligations, DPA, notices, and third-party notices precede further commercialization.

nodes.label: Priority 2 — Signed Release Chain
nodes.rationale: Image signing, provenance linked to the SBOM, signed update manifests, and tested rollback are the next release-engineering controls.

nodes.label: Priority 3 — Operational Resilience
nodes.rationale: Verified PostgreSQL backup and restore, observability, alerting, incident runbooks, and SLOs are required before dependable customer operation.

nodes.label: Priority 4 — Crawler Infrastructure Governance
nodes.rationale: Egress isolation, robots and takedown policy, and CPU, RAM, byte, and browser-minute limits complete the crawler's operational safety boundary.

nodes.label: Priority 5 — P1 Functional Correctness
nodes.rationale: Remaining age, no-website AI, e-commerce, social, token mode, category/locality, and framework-detection defects must be corrected after the structural safeguards.

nodes.label: Priority 6 — Deterministic Evidence Audit
nodes.rationale: Lighthouse, WCAG, security, SEO, and technology detectors should produce evidence for each finding before AI synthesis.

nodes.label: Priority 7 — Gold-set Benchmark and Score Calibration
nodes.rationale: A human-reviewed corpus of 200–500 sites is needed to measure accuracy, hallucinations, stability, and score calibration.

nodes.label: Priority 8 — Queue Hardening
nodes.rationale: Dead-letter queues, cooperative cancellation, phase checkpoints, and resume complete the persistent job architecture.

nodes.label: Priority 9 — Product Frontend and White-label Reports
